_readme: Ad inventory for MetaFlora News. House ads run by default; paid ads (any advertiser other than MetaFlora) win their slots first. format 'native' is drawn in the paper's own type (kind = sell | platform | loyalty picks the illustration in newsroom/ads.py) and lays out wide in article breaks, front bands and list pages, and as a card at the end of articles and on stock pages; card_body is the shorter copy for the card. format 'creative' shows an image as the whole ad (file in newsroom/assets/ads/, needs alt, width, height, shape wide|feature|card). format 'text' is title/body/cta beside a small image. placements limits slots (article, end, front, list, stock); empty = every slot that fits. categories limits sections (empty = everywhere). weight raises frequency. start/end are ISO dates.
